corrected_verdict: KNOWN (upheld): cyclic case of Alon-Roichman 1994 Sec 3.1 (Thm 2 + the Remark after it, which treats Z_n explicitly), with Hoeffding in place of their binomial tail. The unweighted Omega(log n) necessity is also classical (Alon-Roichman Prop 3), so only the budget-weighted (L^r-quasinorm) upper bound and its constants are new.
issues: Every confirmed citation checks out: Alon-Roichman PDF read (Thm 2, per-character bound + union over n-1 characters); Crossref metadata for Alon-Roichman, Naor-Naor, AGHP and Hoeffding; McCracken Thm 4.7 read. Lemma arithmetic re-derived and correct. Problems: (1) The Remark after Alon-Roichman Thm 2 already covers the cyclic group Z_n (eps log2 n random elements give a constant gap a.s.). Cite it as \citet[Sec 3.1]{alon1994random}. (2) Missed by the checker: Alon-Roichman Prop 3 ('If A is an Abelian group of order n, and X(A,S) is a delta-expander, then |S| >= c log2 n') is the classical unweighted counterpart of our matching upper bound and of 'every maximizer uses >= c_s ln p frequencies' (cyclic.tex l.116). So the checker's proposed sentence 'What is new here is the matching upper bound' overclaims. Qualify it: what is new is the budget-weighted upper bound and its constants, via the positive-Fourier argument. (3) The '(one-sided) 1/2-biased multiset of Z_p \citep{naor1993small}' wording is inaccurate. Small bias is two-sided, and at L = ceil(8 ln p) the two-sided union bound exceeds 1, so the draw is not certified 1/2-biased. Naor-Naor and AGHP are over Z_2^n. Either say 'a one-sided analogue of an eps-biased set' and cite Chen-Moore-Russell 2013 (abstract: 'The Alon-Roichman theorem shows that random sets of size O(log|G|/eps^2) suffice'), or drop the sentence. (4) The mccracken2025 bib is wrong. The correct title is 'Uncovering a Universal Abstract Algorithm for Modular Addition in Neural Networks' and the authors are G. McCracken, G. Moisescu-Pareja, V. Letourneau, D. Precup, J. Love. Their Thm 4.7 needs m of about 2.4 ln n at delta = 1/2, so do not present our 8 ln p constant as tight. PROCESS: WebSearch budget exhausted (200/200) on this agent's first call. All sources came from direct WebFetch, Crossref curl and local pdftotext.
